claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.current_item_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item can change between quarterstaff, rod, and 10-foot pole forms, and multiple passive or reactive mechanics are only active in named forms. The surface can alter item kind but cannot gate other mechanics on the current form.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: In certain forms, the weapon has the following additional properties.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item deterministically creates and extinguishes dim light with a fixed radius. No existing effect atom models illumination.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet ... or you can extinguish the light

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_thrown_profile_and_return_to_hand
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item gains a thrown attack profile only in one form and immediately returns after ranged attacks. The current surface has no honest way to author weapon-property grants plus a post-ranged-attack return behavior for a specific item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.
